request: How loaded is the shop over the next three weeks, and is any workstation over its capacity?

work_content.basis: sum(JobCard.time_in_mins x for_qty), the platform's own OEE basis

result.note: capacity_board charges time_in_mins unscaled while the platform's OEE basis defines work content as time_in_mins x for_qty; the two disagree by 94.0x here. Report both figures and do not present either as settled.

content:
**Shop load, next 21 days (Suryodaya Precision Works, INR) — two figures that disagree, so here are both:**

- **Capacity board's own figure: 1.25% load** (1,381 booked minutes vs 110,834 available minutes; 149 open job cards).
- **Work content in the same job cards: 117.1% load** (129,772 minutes, computed as JobCard.time_in_mins × for_qty — the platform's own OEE basis).

These disagree by ~94x because the capacity board charges raw time_in_muns unscaled, while the OEE basis multiplies by for_qty. The platform itself flags this as disputed — I can't present either as settled, and the 117.1% figure is the one consistent with the platform's own definition of work content.

**Workstations over declared capacity (on the work-content figure):**

| Workstation | Name | Work content | Declared capacity | Over |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| WS-2026-00009 | ASSY-01 Assembly & Final Inspection | 72,182 min | 30,240 min | 2.39× |
| WS-2026-00008 | WELD-01 Robotic MIG Cell | 17,920 min | 10,080 min | 1.78× |
| WS-2026-00005 | CNC-02 Haas VF-2 VMC | 15,980 min | 10,080 min | 1.59× |

**Important caveat:** the platform's capacity board currently shows **0 workstations overloaded** — it does not surface these three. So on the board everything looks clear, but on the platform's own OEE basis, assembly is the worst bottleneck at nearly 2.4× its declared capacity, with the MIG weld cell and CNC-02 also over.

Nothing was invisible to this seat here — if you want, I can diagnose what's feeding the ASSY-01 overload (which job cards are consuming it).
